articles.summary: Mobilização começou por volta das 17h e contou com a presença da deputada Federal, Erika Hilton (PSOL-SP).
articles.body:
Apoiadores realizam ato pró-Lula no Ponto de Cem Réis, em João Pessoa — Foto: Ana Beatriz Rocha/TV Cabo Branco

Apoiadores realizaram no final da tarde e no início de noite desta terça-feira (20) um ato em apoio ao presidente Lula (PT), no Ponto de Cem Réis, na capital paraibana João Pessoa .

A mobilização começou por volta das 17h e contou com a presença da deputada federal Erika Hilton (PSOL-SP). Outros apoiadores de Lula na Paraíba, como o deputado estadual eleito, Flávio Brasileiro (PT-PB) também marcaram presença no ato.

Em entrevista para a TV Cabo Branco , Erika Hilton afirmou que a participação dela no evento integra um "fortalecimento" da militância pró-Lula em estados do Nordeste.

"A gente está passando por algumas regiões dos estados da região Nordeste, para organizar, fortalecer e animar a nossa militância, lembrar inclusive os trabalhos do presidente Lula aqui na região Nordeste do nosso país", disse.

O segundo turno das Eleições 2026 acontece no próximo domingo (25). No primeiro turno, na Paraíba, Lula (PT) recebeu 61,31% dos votos válidos, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) teve 33,07%. Nacionalmente, Flávio Bolsonaro ficou na liderança, com 47,03%, contra 45,16% dos votos válidos obtidos por Lula.

articles.title: Moradores criam rede para agir em emergências climáticas em Friburgo  | G1
articles.standfirst: Comunidade do Ruy Sanglard se organizou a partir de mapeamento da Defesa Civil. Moradores relatam medo durante temporais e cobram soluções definitivas para pontos de risco.
articles.summary: Comunidade do Ruy Sanglard se organizou a partir de mapeamento da Defesa Civil. Moradores relatam medo durante temporais e cobram soluções definitivas para pontos de risco.
articles.body:
A proposta é ter moradores como pontos de referência em diferentes partes do bairro — Foto: Divulgação

Moradores do bairro Ruy Sanglard, em Nova Friburgo , na Região Serrana do Rio, decidiram criar uma rede comunitária para tentar agilizar a retirada e o auxílio a pessoas que vivem em áreas de risco durante episódios de chuva forte.

A mobilização foi feita a partir de um mapeamento da Defesa Civil que, segundo a associação de moradores, identificou sete áreas de risco no bairro.

Com essas informações, a comunidade passou a se organizar por setores. A proposta é ter moradores como pontos de referência em diferentes partes do bairro, facilitando a comunicação e a mobilização dos vizinhos caso uma situação de emergência aconteça.

William Chagas , presidente da associação de moradores, explica que a ideia é complementar o trabalho realizado pelos órgãos públicos, principalmente nos primeiros momentos de uma ocorrência.

"A Defesa Civil fez um planejamento, mas, mesmo assim, sabe que tem que ter o apoio da comunidade", afirmou.

Segundo William, quem vive no bairro conhece os pontos mais vulneráveis e pode ajudar a identificar rapidamente onde há pessoas precisando de auxílio. Apesar da mobilização, o presidente da associação afirma que a iniciativa não é uma solução definitiva para o problema.

"O que precisa fazer é moradia. O mapeamento está feito e vamos salvar vidas, mas vai continuar o problema, porque não tem casa, não tem moradia", disse.

A preocupação aparece também nos relatos dos moradores. Em um dos pontos visitados pela nossa equipe, moradores afirmam que um trecho danificado durante as chuvas de dezembro ainda não foi recuperado.

Segundo eles, o problema afetou o acesso pelo local e a circulação do transporte coletivo.

Mônica Bohrer , que mora próximo ao trecho, conta que a preocupação aumenta principalmente durante a madrugada, quando chove forte.

"Chega a noite, madrugada, a gente não dorme direito. Fica com medo disso aí cair mais", contou.

Cláudio Bohrer afirma que os próprios moradores já precisaram se mobilizar para retirar materiais que caíram no local.

"Nós tivemos que alugar caminhão para tirar tudo na mão. Até criança juntou com a gente para fazer a retirada dos materiais", relatou.

Já Laerte Nascimento , comerciante no bairro, afirma que o problema também prejudicou a rotina de quem depende da via.

Segundo ele, moradores precisam caminhar distâncias maiores carregando compras e outros objetos por causa das dificuldades de acesso, além dos impactos para os estabelecimentos comerciais da região.

Prefeitura diz que problema foi provocado por obra irregular

A Secretaria de Defesa Civil informou que a rua está interditada para o tráfego de veículos pesados. Segundo o município, o problema foi provocado por uma obra realizada de forma irregular em um imóvel particular, que teria provocado a queda de um muro e a desestabilização da via.

A Secretaria de Obras informou que está realizando os levantamentos técnicos necessários para elaborar um projeto de recuperação da rua.

Após essa etapa, segundo a prefeitura, a Procuradoria-Geral do Município deverá acionar judicialmente o responsável pelo ocorrido.

Os moradores também pedem a disponibilização de uma van para atender a região enquanto o acesso permanece prejudicado.

Sobre o pedido, a Secretaria de Governo informou que o bairro já conta com uma linha regular de ônibus e uma van que atende a localidade do Vale Radiante, onde, segundo a pasta, existe maior demanda.

A prefeitura afirmou ainda que, neste momento, não há outros veículos disponíveis para atender a área.

Segundo a Defesa Civil, entre os bairros que recebem maior atenção do órgão durante episódios de chuva forte estão Floresta, São Jorge, Ruy Sanglard, São Geraldo, Tingly, Santa Bernadete e Prainha, em Campo do Coelho.

Para William, a experiência criada no Ruy Sanglard poderia ser adotada em outras comunidades.

O presidente da associação defende que moradores conheçam os pontos de risco da região onde vivem e mantenham uma rede de comunicação para situações de emergência.

A experiência criada no Ruy Sanglard poderia ser adotada em outras comunidades. — Foto: Divulgação

articles.title: Reforma Tributária e inteligência artificial devem impulsionar contratações em SP e no ABC em 2027, aponta levantamento | G1

articles.summary: Levantamento da Robert Half destaca oportunidades em Finanças, Tecnologia e Cibersegurança na capital; no ABC, setores automotivo, químico e farmacêutico seguem aquecidos.
articles.body:
Sigla em inglês para inteligência artificial. — Foto: Aly Song/Reuters

A Reforma Tributária , o avanço da inteligência artificial (IA) e as transformações na indústria automotiva devem influenciar o mercado de trabalho em 2027 na cidade de São Paulo e no ABC Paulista segundo um levantamento da consultoria de RH Robert Half.

A análise aponta as áreas de Finanças, Tecnologia, Compras e Comercial entre as que devem concentrar oportunidades de emprego na capital. Já no ABC, a demanda deve ser impulsionada principalmente pelos setores industriais e pela cadeia automotiva .

Na capital paulista, a necessidade de adaptação às mudanças tributárias deve ampliar a procura por especialistas em planejamento tributário, gestão de projetos e análise de dados.

Também estão entre os profissionais mais demandados:

especialistas em segurança da informação;

No ABC, o cenário é marcado pela movimentação da indústria automotiva, com projetos de veículos eletrificados e híbridos, novas plataformas de motores e a entrada de empresas chinesas no mercado.

Especialistas mais procurados para 2027 são:

profissionais das áreas comercial e de tecnologia.

O levantamento aponta também que os segmentos mais aquecidos na capital paulista são varejo, finanças, marketplaces e tecnologia, logística, indústria de bens de consumo e petroquímico.

As áreas que devem liderar as contratações em 2027 são:

articles.title: Conheça plataforma digital que busca soluções para zerar emissões de gases de efeito estufa | G1
articles.standfirst: A ferramenta que foi lançada no Brasil é a única do mundo que permite a participação de qualquer pessoa, mesmo que não seja uma especialista no assunto.
articles.summary: A ferramenta que foi lançada no Brasil é a única do mundo que permite a participação de qualquer pessoa, mesmo que não seja uma especialista no assunto.
articles.body:
Pesquisadores brasileiros ajudaram a criar uma ferramenta digital que mostra o que o Brasil pode fazer para zerar as emissões de gases do efeito estufa. E o acesso é aberto a todos.

Como salvar o mundo do pior cenário do clima? Muitos países já assumiram o compromisso de zerar as emissões de gases estufa, que aquecem o planeta, até 2050. Inclusive o Brasil. E foi justamente no país que um grupo de universidades, empresas e organizações da sociedade civil se uniu para lançar uma plataforma digital que busca soluções para esse imenso desafio.

“A ideia é que, cada vez que alguém proponha um caminho que chegue até zero, esse caminho fique salvo e outras pessoas possam consultar e ver aqueles caminhos. Então, você vai ter dezenas, talvez centenas de possibilidades de como chegar até a emissão zero”, explica Tasso Azevedo, coordenador do MapBiomas e da Rede NetZero Brasil.

A ferramenta oferece várias rotas possíveis para se alcançar esse objetivo : o quanto se pretende investir em energia renovável, na proteção das florestas, na destinação inteligente do lixo, entre outras variáveis. Se o resultado for positivo, ou seja, se a simulação alcançar zero emissão de gases de efeito estufa, a plataforma guarda a informação para consulta aberta ao público.

Conheça plataforma digital que busca soluções para zerar emissões de gases de efeito estufa — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

A ferramenta permite que o usuário escolha que ajustes pretende fazer nos setores que mais emitem gases estufa. Inspirada no modelo criado na Universidade de Princeton, nos Estados Unidos, a plataforma já existe na China, Índia, Austrália, Coreia do Sul e Polônia. A que foi lançada no Brasil é a única do mundo que permite a participação de qualquer pessoa, mesmo que não seja uma especialista no assunto.

“Ela pode ser uma pessoa que está interessada em entender como a trajetória do uso de carros elétricos, por exemplo, pode impactar esse futuro do Brasil sem emissões. Tem caminhos que vão gerar mais empregos, caminhos que vão custar mais caro, caminhos que vão gerar mais renda, caminhos que vão ter mais áreas protegidas, que vão reduzir mais o desmatamento. Então, a ideia é que a gente, todos possam entender esses diferentes caminhos que existem para o Brasil poder chegar a zerar suas emissões”, diz Tasso Azevedo.

articles.body:
Carreta oferece consultas e exames cardiológicos na Bahia — Foto: Arquivo pessoal

Uma carreta de cardiologia do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) começou a atender pacientes na segunda-feira (19), em Feira de Santana , segunda maior cidade da Bahia. A unidade móvel ficará no município por 30 dias, com atendimentos de segunda-feira a sábado, das 7h às 17h, para pacientes encaminhados por 28 municípios da região.

O agendamento deve ser solicitado no posto de saúde mais próximo da residência do paciente, que poderá pedir a marcação de dia e horário para atendimento na carreta. Pessoas que comparecerem sem agendamento poderão procurar a equipe de regulação disponível no local, responsável por coletar os dados, e realizar a marcação do atendimento diretamente .

📍 A carreta está estacionada no pátio da Policlínica Regional de Saúde, na Avenida Eduardo Fróes da Mota, no bairro 35º BI, próximo à Universidade Estadual de Feira de Santana (UEFS). Os atendimentos são realizados dentro da unidade móvel, e não nas instalações da policlínica.

As prefeituras dos municípios atendidos são responsáveis por encaminhar os pacientes a Feira de Santana por meio do transporte para Tratamento Fora do Domicílio (TFD).

monitoramento cardíaco por Holter, durante 24 a 48 horas.

A unidade também realiza avaliação de risco cirúrgico, avaliação cardiológica e diagnóstico de síndrome coronariana crônica e insuficiência cardíaca.

O objetivo da iniciativa é contribuir para o diagnóstico precoce de doenças cardiovasculares, identificar fatores de risco e reduzir o tempo de espera por avaliações e procedimentos médicos especializados.

A equipe da carreta é formada por cardiologista, enfermeiro, técnico de enfermagem, agente do cuidado e profissionais de apoio remoto, que auxiliam no diagnóstico e no acompanhamento dos pacientes.

Nesta quarta-feira (21), às 13h30, o secretário-adjunto de Gestão do Trabalho e da Educação na Saúde do Ministério da Saúde, Jérzey Timóteo, visita a unidade.

articles.title: US citizen injured during ICE detainment in California, officials say
articles.summary: The man was transported to a hospital for medical attention, police said.
articles.body:
California officials are calling for an investigation after they say a man was injured while being detained by federal immigration agents, who were captured on video pinning him down against a curb as he yelled for help during the encounter in Long Beach over the weekend.

California Democratic Rep. Robert Garcia, whose district includes Long Beach, called the incident "incredibly disturbing" and said the man is a U.S. citizen.

In a formal complaint to the Department of Homeland Security, Long Beach Mayor Rex Richardson said the man "reportedly was subjected to repeated Taser use, forcibly restrained, and sustained significant injuries" during Saturday's encounter.

A Department of Homeland Security spokesperson said in a statement that ICE officers "followed their training and used the minimum amount of force" while conducting operations in Long Beach.

Long Beach police officers who responded to the scene Saturday saw a "large group disturbance" involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents and located the man handcuffed and bleeding while being detained by ICE, the Long Beach Police Department said in a statement .

The mayor identified the man in a statement on Monday as Ricardo Gonzalez, referring to him as a "Long Beach resident, father, and former City employee."

In a video posted on social media by StopICE.net, Gonzalez can be heard yelling, "Help me!" while being pinned on the street against a curb. He repeatedly said his arm was broken and could be heard moaning in pain while being detained.

Officers brought him to a local fire station, where they removed his handcuffs, and then firefighters transported him to a local hospital for medical treatment, according to the police department.

It is unclear what specific injuries Gonzalez sustained. A family member told ABC News on Monday that they do not have any comment at this time.

In an online fundraiser, the family member said an unmarked vehicle carrying federal agents struck Gonzalez while he was riding his bicycle. In response to a news report on Gonzalez's injuries that cited the family's account, DHS denied that ICE hit an individual on a bike.

"An individual was arrested after he smashed the mirror of a government vehicle," DHS said in the statement Tuesday, adding that they are "investigating potential charges for the damage to a government vehicle."

According to Richardson's complaint to DHS, Gonzalez contacted the Long Beach Police Department "seeking assistance during a confrontation with federal immigration agents."

Long Beach police said their officers responded after ICE personnel requested emergency assistance from local authorities "due to vehicle vandalism taking place and a subject in need of medical aid."

"LBPD officers were not involved in any immigration enforcement and LBPD personnel did not make any arrests," the police department said.

Garcia, the ranking Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, called for an investigation into the incident.

"There is no reporting that he was doing anything wrong, no public reporting," he said during a press conference on Monday. "Certainly, I have not received any information from our own police department that he was somehow causing some sort of criminal activity."

The Long Beach mayor said he submitted a formal complaint to DHS on Monday "demanding accountability for the actions of federal immigration agents in Long Beach."

"What happened to Ricardo is outrageous and unacceptable," Richardson said in a statement while calling for an independent investigation into the incident. "Long Beach will not stay silent when our neighbors are harmed. A federal badge is not a license to brutalize people or disregard their constitutional rights. If you are entrusted with enforcing the law, you must answer to it."

articles.body: Panchang Today is your steady daily guide for planning life with care, from meetings and travel to prayer and family routines. Aaj Ka Panchang isn’t just about dates and timings, it’s the living rhythm of the Hindu calendar, showing how the Moon’s mood, the Nakshatra’s nature, and the day’s yogas can shape outcomes. When you follow it, you stay connected to cultural roots, and you make choices with a calmer mind. Some days feel like a clear river, others like a windy coast. Today has both. Below are the important Panchang details for October 21, 2026 for India:Date & Day DetailsDate & Day DetailsWednesday arrives with Shukla Paksh 10 (Dasami), a bright fortnight tithi that carries a confident, forward moving pulse. Dasami is often linked with victory, order, and steady courage, the kind that doesn’t shout but still gets results. This tithi remains active until 14:12:01, after which the day steps into Shukla Paksh 11 (Ekadasi). So the first half of your day suits action and decision, while the later half naturally leans toward restraint, reflection, and cleaner choices. If you’ve been putting off a difficult conversation or a pending follow up, the Dasami hours can help you speak with spine, not stress.The Nakshatra is Dhanistha, lasting until 19:47:56, and then it transitions into Satabhisaj. Dhanistha is guided by the Ashta Vasus, the deities connected with light, flow, and nourishment in different forms. Think of it like the sky after rain, fresh energy that supports movement, teamwork, music, and practical prosperity. Dhanistha also has a drumbeat quality, good for routines, training, and coordinated effort. Work that needs timing, like presentations, interviews, logistics, or even a disciplined study schedule, finds support here. After 19:47:56, Satabhisaj takes over, ruled by Varuna, carrying a more private, healing, and research minded tone. Evening hours can suit quiet planning, journaling, and clearing mental clutter.The Moon begins in Capricorn 29.28, and shifts into Aquarius at 07:00:25. That’s a real change in emotional weather. Capricorn Moon can feel like a strict timetable, focused on duty and results. Aquarius Moon, on the other hand, wants ideas, community, and new angles. If you wake up feeling serious or a bit burdened, don’t judge it. After 07:00:25, you may find it easier to think creatively, delegate, or reach out to a group.Yoga for the day is Ganda, ending at 00:33:05, followed by Vriddhi. Ganda yoga can bring knots, delays, and misunderstandings if you rush or assume. Vriddhi supports growth and improvement, as long as you’re patient. Karan also matters for the day’s texture. Gara Karan continues until 14:12:01, then Vanij continues until 02:36:00, followed by Visti. Gara is good for steady effort, while Vanij has a trade and transaction flavour. Still, choose your timing wisely, because other inauspicious blocks exist today.Actionable advice: Use the post 07:00:25 Aquarius Moon for brainstorming and teamwork, and use the pre 14:12:01 Dasami strength for the most important task you’ve been delaying.Auspicious Timings (Shubh Muhurat)Auspicious Timings (Shubh Muhurat)The day opens with Brahma Muhurta from 04:18:50 to 05:09:06. This is the hush before the world stirs, when the mind is less noisy and prayer goes deeper. If you can wake up for it, even 15 minutes of japa, breathwork, or reading a sacred text can set your mood like a lamp set in a window. Right after that, Pratah Sandhya runs from 04:43:58 to 05:59:22, a strong window for Surya arghya, simple gratitude, and intention setting. Don’t overcomplicate it. A clean corner, a diya, and a sincere prayer is enough.Amrit Kalam arrives from 08:38:15 to 10:21:11, a sweet stretch for important calls, starting a meaningful piece of work, sending a proposal, or visiting elders. The energy here is like a well watered field, things take root faster. Then comes Vijay Muhurta from 13:36:42 to 14:22:26, a classic victory window. If you must push for an outcome, argue your case, present your work, or chase approvals, this is the time to try.Ravi Yoga is present from 05:59:22 to 19:47:19. It’s known to strengthen positive outcomes and reduce the sting of ordinary obstacles, especially for career progress, learning, and initiatives that need steady confidence. Evening brings Godhuli Muhurta from 17:25:38 to 17:50:46, a gentle bridge between day and night, ideal for lamp lighting, family togetherness, and calming rituals. Sayahana Sandhya lasts from 17:25:38 to 18:41:02, suitable for evening prayers and closing the day with dignity. For those awake late, Nishita Muhurta runs from 23:17:30 to 00:07:46, a powerful time for mantra, deep contemplation, and inner reset.Choghadiya auspicious periods also guide daily choices. Daytime brings Laabh @ 05:59, Amrit @ 07:24, Shubh @ 10:16, and Laabh @ 15:59. At night, Shubh @ 18:59, Amrit @ 20:34, and Laabh @ 26:51 support good outcomes.Actionable advice: Pick one key goal and schedule it inside Amrit Kalam 08:38:15 to 10:21:11 or Vijay Muhurta 13:36:42 to 14:22:26, then keep the rest of the day simple and steady.Inauspicious TimingsInauspicious TimingsRahu Kaal today is from 11:42 to 13:08. During 11:42 to 13:08, avoid new ventures, big purchases, signing contracts, and locking in financial decisions. Keep your wallet closed today if you can. What can you do instead? Routine work, cleaning your inbox, revising notes, and spiritual protection practices do well. A few rounds of chanting, especially the Rahu mantra “Om Raam Rahave Namaha”, can settle the mind and reduce anxious thinking.The verified inauspicious list also gives Rahu Kaal from 11:42:30 to 13:08:17, the same period shown down to the second. Use it as a tighter boundary if you like precision.Before Rahu Kaal, Gulkai Kaal falls from 10:16:43 to 11:42:30. If you have an early commute or appointment, keep buffer time, and double check documents and payments.Varjyam is from 03:23:25 to 04:58:18. Don’t rush into commitments late morning.There are broader caution flags too. Baana (Nripa) runs from 20:31:22 to 05:59:54, and Panchaka from 07:01:22 to 05:59:54. articles.title: A San Francisco power station closed in 2011 is being transformed into a waterfront district with 2,300 homes, parks and new public spaces
articles.summary: A former power station on San Francisco’s waterfront, decommissioned in 2011, is being transformed into a mixed-use district with thousands of homes,
articles.body: A former power station on San Francisco’s waterfront, decommissioned in 2011, is being transformed into a mixed-use district with thousands of homes, parks, shops and public spaces. The Potrero Power Station redevelopment aims to open a stretch of the city’s central waterfront that remained closed to the public for around 150 years. The project will combine new housing and workplaces with public access to the bay, while preserving important elements of the industrial site. Plans also include affordable homes, community facilities and spaces for recreation.How will San Francisco’s former power station become a waterfront districtThe Potrero Power Station site lies directly south of Pier 70 along San Francisco Bay. According to Perkins&Will, the redevelopment covers a 21-acre parcel, while the wider master plan documented by San Francisco Planning covers approximately 29 acres, including additional land associated with the project.The power station once supplied electricity to the city before closing in 2011. Its redevelopment is intended to give the former industrial property a new purpose by introducing housing, businesses and publicly accessible outdoor spaces.The plans include approximately 2,300 mixed-use and mixed-income homes, with 30% designated as affordable housing. The transformation is designed to create a neighbourhood where people can live, work and spend time by the water, rather than leaving the former industrial property separated from the surrounding city.The redevelopment brings housing and employment togetherHousing is only one part of the proposed transformation. The development plans also provide space for offices, laboratories, shops, light industry, arts activities and community services.Perkins&Will outlines approximately 100,000 square feet of retail space, 1.6 million square feet of laboratory and office space, and 130,000 square feet for light industrial and arts uses. These facilities are intended to support a mixture of employment and everyday activities within the neighbourhood.The combination is intended to give the district a broader role than that of a residential development. People working in its offices and laboratories could use nearby shops and restaurants, while residents would have access to services and leisure spaces within the neighbourhood.What public spaces will the waterfront development providePublic access is a central part of the redevelopment. According to San Francisco Planning, the approved master plan includes approximately 6.9 acres of new open space, featuring parks, recreational areas, pedestrian routes and an extension of the Bay Trail.One of the most significant elements is a waterfront park designed to open more than 1,000 linear feet of shoreline to the public. This would give visitors a new opportunity to reach and experience a section of the bayfront that had been inaccessible for generations.The plan also identifies Power Station Park, covering approximately 1.2 acres, and Stack Plaza, covering around 0.6 acres. Other proposed amenities include a playground, areas for active and quieter recreation, and a rooftop football pitch.These spaces are intended to make the development useful beyond its residential and commercial buildings. Walking routes and open areas would provide places to exercise, meet other people and spend time outdoors. It also lists a network of new streets, cycling infrastructure and transportation improvements as part of the wider project.Historic industrial structures will remain part of the neighbourhoodAlthough the site is being substantially redeveloped, the plans do not call for every reminder of its industrial past to disappear.San Francisco Planning identifies Station A and the iconic boiler stack among the structures intended for preservation. The Unit 3 power block may also be retained, subject to the approved plans and applicable design requirements.The stack is particularly prominent in the proposals. Perkins&Will describes the approximately 300-foot-tall structure as a landmark that will remain as a reminder of the area's history. The approach combines older structures with new buildings and public areas. It is intended to give the neighbourhood a recognisable connection to its former use.The project will take shape over several decadesThe scale of the redevelopment means the neighbourhood will not appear all at once. San Francisco Planning states that construction is expected to proceed in multiple phases over a 30-year period, with each phase requiring approval through the city's planning process.The first signs of the housing programme have already emerged. Perkins&Will reports that an 8-storey building containing 105 affordable homes opened in autumn 2025. The firm also states that construction began in 2026 on a University of California, San Francisco life sciences building at the site.The planning process has also involved community participation. Quarterly public workshops, monthly site tours and weekly office hours intended to keep residents informed and provide opportunities to engage with the proposals.You use AI every day. articles.title: Lula, Bolsonaro seek to disqualify each other ahead of Brazil runoff
articles.summary: Messaging service WhatsApp and parent company Meta are embroiled in legal attacks by Brazil’s presidential candidates.
articles.body:
Both candidates for the Brazilian presidency have called for the disqualification of their rivals over allegations of social media interference, ramping up political drama ahead of the close-fought October 25 runoff election.

Brazil’s right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro has requested the annulment of the candidacy of his rival, President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, over what he called unlawful propaganda.

Lawyers for Bolsonaro filed a request with the Superior Electoral Court on Tuesday, alleging Lula’s “abuse of power” in the mass dissemination of government postings during the campaign period via WhatsApp.

Bolsonaro’s camp claimed the Brazilian government sent mass messages to millions of Brazilians via the messaging service, promoting social programmes, benefits and government initiatives in the midst of the presidential race, Brazilian media reported.

The request to the electoral court seeks to declare Lula and Social Communications Minister Sidonio Palmeira ineligible to hold public office for a period of eight years.

In the other camp, Lula’s campaign said on Tuesday that it would request the disqualification of Bolsonaro on Wednesday over alleged election interference by WhatsApp parent company, the tech giant Meta.

Lula’s petition, which has yet to be officially filed, alleges “algorithmic manipulation” by Meta aimed at harming Lula’s chances of winning, a campaign source told AFP.

The electoral court had given Meta 24 hours on Monday to prove it was complying with an order to treat both campaigns equally, threatening a daily fine of around $200,000 if it didn’t.

The order came after Lula’s campaign alleged that Meta, which owns Facebook, WhatsApp and Instagram, was suppressing his online content to boost Bolsonaro.

“We have completed the implementation of the measures to comply with the Superior Electoral Court’s decision,” the company said on Tuesday.

Lula and Bolsonaro are locked in a heated presidential race after the right-wing candidate, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, won the initial round of voting earlier this month with 47 percent of the vote to the incumbent’s 45 percent.

Polls show a very close race ahead of Sunday’s runoff round.

articles.body: NEW DELHI: US secretary of state Marco Rubio on Wednesday dismissed the term “UN experts” as an “oxymoron” when asked about the United Nations' criticism of India's handling of anti-Election Commission protests, calling the issue a "domestic political matter" that should be decided by Indians.Asked about protests by opposition parties and students in India and UN experts' allegations of a crackdown on demonstrators, Rubio said Washington would not interfere in the country's internal politics."Well the UN experts, my favourite. The UN experts is an oxymororn," he said.He added that India was a democracy with elections and said he would not comment on its domestic political matters.“No, it's a domestic political matter. This is a democracy, they have elections here. I am not going to opine on their political matters,” Rubio said.Rubio distinguished peaceful demonstrations from riots involving vandalism and destruction of property, saying the ability to express differing political opinions was an important feature of democratic societies."I am not talking about the riots, what you see in Europe. They are vandalizing and breaking and burning down buildings. I am not talking about that," he said.India rejects UN experts' allegationsRubio's remarks come amid a diplomatic exchange over concerns raised by UN experts about India's handling of protests. The experts had alleged restrictions on peaceful assembly and raised concerns over the alleged excessive use of force against demonstrators and reports of enforced disappearances.India pushed back against the criticism at the United Nations on Tuesday, rejecting what it described as attempts to portray the country negatively on the basis of unverified allegations and incomplete statistics.Indian diplomat Barkha Tamrakar told the UN that constitutional safeguards, including Article 21, protect human rights and ensure due process.“India firmly opposes any attempt to convert unverified allegations, incomplete statistics, or a report that contains no India country observation into a negative characterization of the world's largest democracy,” Tamrakar said.“Human rights should not be used as an instrument of political pressure or selective country targeting,” she added.India also called for impartial and evidence-based engagement on human rights, arguing against what it described as selective scrutiny of countries.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: More than 1 billion pounds of US pumpkins are estimated to end up in landfills after Halloween each year, even though seeds and safely handled flesh can be used as food
articles.summary: More than 1 billion pounds of pumpkins end up in U.S. landfills after Halloween every year. Discover how to reduce waste and utilize pumpkins effectively, including food safety tips and composting strategies.
articles.body: Halloween produces a lot of mess in its wake. Plastic costumes. Candy wrappers. And then, after a few weeks, the sagging jack-o'-lanterns that hang on porches until they collapse and start to develop fur. Few people think of discarded pumpkins as food waste, even though an intact pumpkin could have been cooked and its seeds roasted just days earlier. After Halloween, many are tossed into the garbage without a second thought.The Associated Press, citing the US Department of Energy, reported that more than 1 billion pounds (about 454 million kilograms) of pumpkins end up in American landfills each year after Halloween. That is a yearly projection, not a new 2025 tally, but it is big enough to make a difference. The problem is not just a wasted vegetable. As food decomposes in a landfill, methane is emitted. According to the EPA, food makes up roughly 24% of what goes into municipal landfills but about 58% of the methane that escapes from them.So what should happen to a pumpkin once the candle is blown out? The answer is a little more nuanced than simply eating it. Seeds are generally fine; the flesh depends on how the pumpkin was handled, and whatever is left can go to a compost heap or a farm instead of the bin.Why landfills make things worsePumpkins are mostly water, so they decay quickly. When buried under other waste with little oxygen, they decompose and release methane, a greenhouse gas that traps significantly more heat than carbon dioxide. The US Department of Energy has estimated that American pumpkin production is roughly 1.3 billion pounds a year. Because many pumpkins are discarded around the same time after Halloween, landfills receive a concentrated influx of wet food waste.The same analysis found that food waste contributes more methane than any other type of material in municipal solid-waste landfills. Methane emissions from landfilled food waste have also increased even as overall methane emissions from these landfills have declined. A stack of old pumpkins is a minor but perfectly avoidable source for a government attempting to cut methane.What is safe to eatSeeds are the low-hanging fruit. Michigan State University says any pumpkin seeds can be roasted and eaten as a snack. The meat is tougher. But after the pumpkin is carved, it’s considered a perishable item, and the university recommends not leaving it sitting between 40 and 140 degrees Fahrenheit, or 4 to 60 degrees Celsius, for more than two hours. So a jack-o’-lantern that has spent a night on the porch should be composted rather than fried. Oklahoma State University Extension offers similar advice, stating the flesh of a carved pumpkin is not safe to eat after sitting at room temperature for hours or days.A better way is to handle cooking and carving as two independent jobs. Carving pumpkins are often a different variety from pie pumpkins and are not bred primarily for eating. Their flesh tends to be stringier and milder in flavor than that of pumpkins used for cooking. Anyone who wants soup or pie can buy an extra pie pumpkin, cook it fresh, and save the big one for display. To utilize a carving pumpkin safely, cook the flesh right after carving it, before it has been left out for hours.Composting and farm donationLeftover pumpkins can be fed to animals or composted. Uncoated pumpkins can be donated to local farms for animal feed, while inedible leftovers can be composted. If you don’t have a heap of your own pumpkins, they can be dropped off at a farm, a compost bin or a collection location. First, remove candles, plastic, glitter and paint, as these contaminate the compost. Pumpkins are mostly water, so they need a balance of dry stuff like dried leaves, wood chips, straw or shredded cardboard. Without it, the pile gets stinky.For longer storage, University of Georgia Extension recommends freezing pumpkin; its seeds can also be dried or roasted. Mashed or pureed pumpkin should not be canned at home because no tested-safe method is available for those products. The message from the experts is pragmatic rather than preachy. Eat the seeds, cook an uncarved or pie pumpkin, send carved ones to a farm or compost heap, and keep them out of the bin. Do that, and a billion-pound problem goes down to something a lot smaller.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.
